name: Aviat Husky
variants: A-1A / A-1B (180 hp, higher gross weight)
summary: Tandem two-seat, strut-braced bush and utility plane from Wyoming; a modern Super Cub-class type often seen on floats or big tundra tires.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
Large flaps and a rugged, short-field wing
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four (180–200 hp) in a deep cowl
Constant-speed propeller, often two- or three-blade
fuselage: Tandem two-seat cabin with large glazing, wider than a Super Cub's
Tailwheel gear, usually with oversized tundra tires or floats

tellTales: Tandem two-seat bush plane with a deep nose and a big constant-speed prop
Strut-braced high wing with big flaps
Tall squared tail over a tailwheel

confusedWith.howToTell: The Husky has a bigger engine and a wider, deeper cabin; the PA-18 is slimmer with a smaller cowl.
The Husky seats two in tandem; the Maule seats four with side-by-side front seats and a boxier cabin.
The Husky has a deeper fuselage, big flaps and a bigger engine; the Citabria has a slimmer cabin and a smaller cowl.
The Husky has two tandem seats and an angular tail; the 180 has side-by-side seating and four seats.
